uart_address_range: device_number = uart_address - 0x20 (a synthetic MCU ProgCom index, NOT the physical I2C/TWI address)

STATUS.description: Table 28. There is no separate STATUS_SUMMARY byte on x4 -- see TEMP_ALARM/VCC_ALARM below.

LOS_ALARMS.description: Combined TX/RX Loss of Signal alarms, Table 29.

TX_FAULT_LATCH.description: Latched TX fault flags (4 channels, bits 0-3), Table 30.

CDR_LOL_ALARMS.description: CDR Loss of Lock alarms, Table 31.

TEMP_ALARM.description: Temperature alarms/warnings, Table 32. This is the byte previously (incorrectly) documented as STATUS_SUMMARY at this address.

ELAPSED_TIME.description: Operating time, 16-bit unsigned (2 hours LSB). Byte 0x26 (previously documented here) is actually Rx3 Measured Optical Power on this variant -- an active mismatch, not just a mislabel.

VCC_MONITOR.description: Supply voltage, 16-bit unsigned (100 µV LSB), range 0-6.55V

RX_OPTICAL_POWER.description: 4 channels x 2 bytes, unsigned, 0.1 µW/count, accuracy ±3dB. Bytes 34-41: Rx1=0x22-23, Rx2=0x24-25, Rx3=0x26-27, Rx4=0x28-29.

TX_DISABLE.description: Per-channel TX disable (bits 0-3 for CH0-CH3), byte 86, Table 35.

CDR_ENABLE.description: Byte 98, Table 36. Bits 7-4 = Tx4-Tx1 CDR enable, bits 3-0 = Rx4-Rx1 CDR enable. Default 0xFF (all enabled).

LOS_MASK.description: Combined TX/RX LOS alarm mask, byte 100, Table 38.

TX_FAULT_MASK.description: Mask TX fault interrupts, byte 101, Table 39.

CDR_LOL_MASK.description: Mask CDR LOL alarms, byte 102, Table 40.

RESET.description: No software-reset register is defined for this variant. Byte 0x33 (previously documented here) is reserved -- do not write to it expecting a reset.

RX_DISABLE.description: No per-channel RX channel-disable control is defined for this variant (byte 0x36, previously documented here, is reserved). Do not substitute RX_OUTPUT_DISABLE for this -- they are different controls with different semantics.

FIRMWARE_VER.description: Reserved on this variant; no firmware-version field.

EEPROM_REV.description: Reserved on this variant; no EEPROM-revision field.

MAX_TEMP.description: Max recommended case temp, byte 190, Table 43. Datasheet states a fixed value of 70°C for this field; the exact byte encoding is not independently re-verified here (source PDF table extraction was ambiguous for this row).

SERIAL_NUMBER.description: Datasheet Table 43 places a 16-character ASCII serial number at bytes 196-211 (0xC4-0xD3). NOT enabled in the Python API: a different, previously-tried address (0xBD) was confirmed absent on installed B0425040011201 devices, and this 0xC4 location has not yet been independently confirmed against real deployed hardware. Do not enable without that confirmation.

0x01.description: Reserved/not used for module alarm thresholds on this variant -- see upper page 0x03 instead.

0x03.description: Module Alarm Thresholds (Table 45) plus per-channel controls. The datasheet's overview table marks these R/W; its introductory prose separately calls the threshold values 'factory pre-set' -- this ambiguity is unresolved here, so do not assume write support without further confirmation.

TX_POLARITY_INV.description: Byte 226, per-channel TX/RX polarity invert (packed fields), Table 46.

RX_OUTPUT_AMP.description: Bytes 238-239, Table 49 (packed fields; manufacturer text notes amplitude is not fully independent per channel).

RX_OUTPUT_DISABLE.description: Byte 241, per-channel electrical RX output disable, Table 51. There is no corresponding RX channel-disable control on this variant (see lower_page_registers.RX_DISABLE).

TEMP_BIN_BASE.description: 22 temperature bins x 3 bytes (24-bit counters), bytes 128-193, Table 53.

PEAK_TEMP.description: Peak recorded case temperature (°C), byte 194, immediately following the bin array.

rx_output_amplitude_table.description: Values for upper_pages.0x03.RX_OUTPUT_AMP (Table 49). Previously mislabeled 'tx_output_amplitude_table' -- there is no per-channel TX amplitude control on this variant.

notes: Memory map based on Firefly Manual ECUO 25G_28G x4 Revision_1.0.pdf, not the InfiniBand CXP 12-channel spec used for the x12 variants -- addresses are NOT interchangeable with firefly12.json.
All multi-byte values are Big Endian
Upper pages selected via PAGE_SELECT at 0x7F
4-channel devices use packed register fields (1 byte vs 2 bytes for 12-channel)
Data rates: 10G/14G/25G/28G per channel depending on model
